description: Refine a previous CielStay search in natural language, such as "more rustic", "closer to the park", "better views", "bigger place" or "with ping pong". For any follow-up that adds to or changes an earlier search in the conversation; keeps that search's place and dates. Takes the original query plus the refinement, and the earlier `currentIntent` as previousIntent; no session or token is needed.

persona.description: Carry the same persona through from the original search, if you sent one.

previousIntent.description: The `currentIntent` object from the previous response, if you still have it. Preserves location and dates across the refinement. Optional — omit it and the refinement still works.

query.description: The original search query you want to refine, exactly as you sent it before.

refinement.description: Natural language refinement instruction. Examples: "more rustic and less modern", "closer to the water", "something with better views", "bigger — needs 3+ bedrooms".

traveller.description: The traveller fields from the original search, with anything the traveller has added since. Used for ranking and never stored.

name: refine_search

currentIntent.description: Pass to refine_search as previousIntent to keep place and dates

rankedFor.description: What these results were ranked for: place, guests, dates, amenities, traveller

rankingQuestion.description: Present when nothing is known about the traveller: the question whose answer would most change this ranking. An answer can be sent as `traveller`

bookUrl.description: The host's booking page, opened through CielStay so the referral is counted

messageHostUrl.description: Present only when someone can receive a message about this home: the listing page opened at its message form with the stay filled in (free)

basis.description: What the figure is: e.g. avg_night_incl_fees, avg_nightly_rate_excl_fees, host_set, monthly_rent

label.description: The qualifier to show next to the price

readyToBook.description: Where to book; with dates, availability and the total on the host's site where it can be read

title: Refine a search
